Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_Enable_tooltip: The Knox strain mutates: bodies rise as forms, some go past death into the crossed, some come back as the afflicted.\nOff: ZAO runs nothing and no pathogen state is produced.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_MutationOdds_too: The odds that an infection produces a mutation, for bodies that have not already mutated.\nThe baseline is 10% or lower; the roll is uniform across the gradient unless weighted below.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_Controller_toolt: Claimed bodies with a form or an attribute mutation are driven toward what they are.\nOff: forms still exist in the record - nothing acts on them.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_Overlay_tooltip: The state panel shows the pathogen state of the body you are looking at.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_Mind_tooltip: What remains of the person decides what the body can still do: perception, disposition, standing, and execution all read from the record.\nIdentity decay is episodic - it happens in episodes, never per tick.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_Settlement_toolt: Groups of the turned can sometimes form a settlement - a new place, kept, occupied, grouped. Rare on purpose.\nOff: the turned never keep a place.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_Recovery_tooltip: A body that survives an infection, or is cured by the antibodies mod's treatment, keeps the state the pathogen already changed.\nSurvival does not erase the fact that the pathogen acted.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_CrossedOdds_tool: Every infection carries a random variable of its own. Most infections do not have it.\nOne that does makes the body sicker faster and carries it past death into the crossed state.\nRare by default: 2.5%.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_AfflictedSuscept: How many times more likely an afflicted body is to go crossed than anyone else, when a crossed carrier exposes them.\nThe operator's default is 5. It is the thing the afflicted fear most.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_GrowthRate_toolt: How fast a form grows toward its full performance each day, at full human capability.\nThe operator's baseline: growth runs at the mutation odds themselves.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_PassiveDecayRate: How much of the body's human capability is passively lost each day while the form grows.\nExtrapolated from the operator's baseline: a tenth of the mutation odds.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_ReversionOdds_to: The odds each day that a mutant body reverts - coming back short of human as one of the afflicted, keeping ability inversely to the performance it had reached.\nExtrapolated from the operator's baseline: a tenth of the mutation odds.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_OutlierEffect_to: The extra reversion risk carried by the outliers - a body performing near its ceiling or its floor.\nExtrapolated from the operator's baseline: a fifth of the mutation odds.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_IdentityDecayOdd: The odds each day that an afflicted body suffers a further fragmentation episode.\nNot every afflicted body loses more over time. Rare by default.\nBeyond this dial and the depth below, the process is genuinely random - which axis it loses varies per body.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_IdentityDecayDep: How much one fragmentation episode takes from the axes it touches.\nMild by default.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_ResistanceInfect: The number of infections a body must survive to become resistant.\nThe operator's default: 2.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_ImmunityInfectio: The number of infections a body must survive to become immune.\nThe operator's default: 5.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_CrossedEngageDea: By default the crossed ignore the dead and hunt the living.\nOn: they will also fight the risen.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_SettlementOdds_t: The odds each day that turned bodies lingering together at a place actually form a settlement there.\nRare on purpose. A settlement is what these bodies did, never a placement.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_FormWeightPuker_: The relative weight of the Puker on the form roll. All weights at 1 is the uniform default.\nSet a weight to 0 to keep that form out of the gradient.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_FormWeightHusk_t: The relative weight of the Husk on the form roll. All weights at 1 is the uniform default.\nSet a weight to 0 to keep that form out of the gradient.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_FormWeightSkitte: The relative weight of the Skitter on the form roll. All weights at 1 is the uniform default.\nSet a weight to 0 to keep that form out of the gradient.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_FormWeightWrecke: The relative weight of the Wrecker on the form roll. All weights at 1 is the uniform default.\nSet a weight to 0 to keep that form out of the gradient.
Sandbox_ZombieAwareness_FormWeightLeaper: The relative weight of the Leaper on the form roll. All weights at 1 is the uniform default.\nSet a weight to 0 to keep that form out of the gradient.
